content.short: EVM Toolkit provides tools for creating and analyzing smart contract programs on the Ethereum Virtual Machine.
content.description: EVM Toolkit provides a dual-set approach for analyzing smart contracts running on the Ethereum Virtual Machine. It comprises two crates: etk-asm for assembly-related tasks and etk-dasm for disassembly. The etk-dasm crate disassembles binary or hex-encoded code and identifies blocks of instructions to help analysts trace control flow and program structure. The etk-asm crate centralizes files from diverse sources into a single project layout and offers a suite of utilities to manage artifacts, streamline navigation, and support broader analysis workflows.
